It does not exchange data with SIGA: it publishes to the gateway of its classroom, and the gateway relays the readings. In a DFD a flow may not join two external entities, so drawing sensor to gateway would break the notation. The gateway is the boundary, and F17 probes it rather than the sensors, because what can be lost is the gateway." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="560" x="400" y="790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Why the IoT sensor is not drawn here. It does not exchange data with SIGA: it publishes to the gateway of its classroom, and the gateway relays the readings. In a DFD a flow may not join two external entities, so drawing sensor to gateway would break the notation. The gateway is the boundary, and F17 probes it rather than the sensors, because what can be lost is the gateway.
